title: Handle tasks.json with all tasks complete in rocket loop
description: In preflight, if tasks.json exists but all tasks have passes:true, show a success message and exit gracefully without starting the loop.
acceptanceCriteria: Running rocket loop when all tasks are complete shows 'All tasks are already complete!' message

steps.details: In runPreflight, after reading tasks: if (getIncompleteTasks(tasks).length === 0) { throw new Error('All tasks are already complete! Use rocket status to see the summary.') }

steps.description: Handle this error gracefully in loop.ts
steps.details: In loop.ts, catch the specific error: if (error.message.includes('already complete')) { console.log('\n✅ All tasks are already complete!'); tasks.forEach(t => console.log(` ✓ #${t.id} ${t.title}`)); process.exit(0) }
